best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a clean fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 118 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 69/100, and good wind at 20 km/h.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.  Expect: it is less reliable than the main bay spots, so weak swell or short period can make it feel soft.

ranked.explanation: Lagide looks like a fun-sized window for Fun progression, Medium confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 116 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 69/100, and wind is not fully clear. A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.  Expect: it can feel softer or less defined than the main peaks, and rocks may appear closer to the west cliffs.
